title: ISRO ICRB Assistant and Other Various Post Online Form 2026
organization: Indian Space Research Organisation – Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB)
postName: Assistant, Junior Personal Assistant, Upper Division Clerk, Stenographer (Advt. ISRO:ICRB:01(A-JPA):2026)
vacancyDetails: About 242–244 posts: Assistants, Junior Personal Assistants, Upper Division Clerk and Stenographers under centralised ICRB recruitment 2026
qualification: Graduation for Assistant / UDC / JPA as per post; Stenography skill for Stenographer / JPA posts – see detailed ISRO bilingual advertisement
ageLimit: As per ISRO ICRB Advt 01(A-JPA):2026 (category-wise relaxation applicable)

shortDescription: ISRO ICRB Assistant, JPA, UDC & Stenographer Online Form 2026 for ~242 posts. Apply 27 July–16 August 2026 at isro.gov.in. Advt ICRB:01(A-JPA):2026.
content:
ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB) has released Advt. No. ISRO:ICRB:01(A-JPA):2026 dated 27 July 2026 for recruitment of Assistants, Junior Personal Assistants, Upper Division Clerks and Stenographers.

Total posts: ~242. Online applications: 27 July 2026 to 16 August 2026.

Posts

  • Assistant
  • Junior Personal Assistant (JPA)
  • Upper Division Clerk (UDC)
  • Stenographer

Fee (overview)

  • One post: ₹500 | Two posts: ₹1000
  • Partial/full refund after appearing in CBT as per category rules in the notice

Apply only through the official link on isro.gov.in. Read skill-test requirements carefully for JPA and Stenographer posts.
